THE BRONX, N.A. — A routine security deployment took a chaotic turn outside a funeral service for a slain NYPD detective when a police K-9 managed to break loose and attack a nearby bystander. The incident occurred during the memorial service for Detective Didarul Islam, drawing immediate panic from attendees and pedestrians on the sidewalk. According to preliminary reports, the German Shepherd was inside a parked Suffolk County Police Department patrol vehicle when a minor collision between two police cruisers caused a rear vehicle door to unlatch. Seizing the opportunity, the dog escaped through the open door and charged directly toward a crowd gathered along the sidewalk. Eyewitness video captured the tense moments as the loose K-9 latched onto a bystander's clothing, prompting immediate intervention from handlers and nearby officers who rushed to restrain the animal. The victim sustained minor injuries, including a visible scratch from the bite, but was treated at the scene and reported to be in stable condition. Following the public outcry and viral spread of the footage online, the Suffolk County Police Department confirmed it has launched a formal internal investigation into the vehicle's door mechanism and standard K-9 containment protocols to prevent similar security failures in the future.
